pillars_head.h2:
Learn to master six pillars
of a longer, better life.
pillars_head.sub: The interconnected systems, nutrition, sleep, movement, supplements and wearables, stress, and your personal protocol, that compound a longer, better life across every decade.

pillars.title: Nutrition
pillars.text: Turn your kitchen into a medicine cabinet with plant-forward, nutrient-dense food patterns that fight inflammation and drive cellular rejuvenation.

pillars.title: Sleep
pillars.text: Science-backed protocols that rebuild your sleep architecture, the most underutilised longevity lever, regulating cortisol rhythm, HGH secretion and glymphatic clearance.

pillars.title: Exercise and Movement
pillars.text: Build a resilient body through functional strength, Zone 2 endurance and stability, so you extend lifespan and healthspan together.

pillars.title: Supplements and Wearables
pillars.text: NAD+ precursors, omega-3s, D3 with K2, magnesium and the rest deployed against your specific biomarker gaps, never stacked by trend. CGM, HRV and sleep data close the loop.

pillars.title: Stress Management
pillars.text: Autonomic regulation, structured breathwork, deliberate cold exposure and vagal tone training against cortisol dysregulation and rising allostatic load.

pillars.title: Your Longevity Protocol
pillars.text: Your own bloodwork, ApoB, fasting insulin, inflammatory markers, body composition and wearable data become one individualised plan you own and keep iterating.

items.a: For ambitious people who want to optimize their health, energy, and longevity through science-backed nutrition, exercise, recovery, and biomarker tracking. Perfect for high performers, wellness enthusiasts, and anyone ready to take a proactive approach to living longer and feeling better.

items.q: Do I need any medical background?
items.a: No. This course is designed for anyone interested in improving their health, energy, and longevity. You don't need a medical, scientific, or fitness background to participate. We break down complex topics into practical, easy to understand concepts and help you apply them to your own life through simple tracking, actionable exercises, and personalized insights.

items.q: What happens in a typical session?
items.a: Each week, you'll join a 50-minute live session with expert instructors and a community of like-minded people focused on optimizing health, performance, and longevity. Sessions combine science-backed learning, real biomarker and CGM data analysis, and interactive discussions around nutrition, movement, sleep, and recovery. You'll leave with a personalized experiment to apply during the week, turning your own data into actionable insights for long-term health and vitality.

No. This program is educational and focused on helping you better understand the science of longevity, nutrition, movement, recovery, and biomarker tracking. We do not diagnose, treat, or provide clinical care. Our instructors help you interpret research, understand your own health data, and build sustainable lifestyle practices. For medical concerns or clinical decisions, please continue working with your physician.

items.q: What do I get when I complete the course?
items.a: Your Personal Longevity Blueprint, a written protocol covering nutrition, movement, sleep, stress, supplements, and the signals you'll keep watching. You also finish with a CGM synthesis, a set of food and sleep experiments you can re-run, and a personal continuation plan you'll carry beyond the 18-week program.

Tuition is $279 per month for five months. It includes all 18 live sessions, full access to our learning platform, the continuous glucose monitor (CGM) device, and shipping. Speak with our admissions team to confirm availability.

items.q: What technology or equipment do I need?
items.a: All you need is a laptop or tablet for live sessions and a smartphone to track your progress throughout the program. our Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) is included with enrollment and will be shipped directly to you, arriving before Lesson 5, when the CGM portion of the program begins. Any additional tools, such as a smartwatch, sleep tracker, or fitness wearable, are completely optional and will be discussed throughout the course.

items.q: Can I catch up if I miss a session?
items.a: Absolutely. All sessions are recorded and available to watch on demand. While we recommend attending live to benefit from expert guidance and class discussions, you'll be able to review the session and access all course materials whenever your schedule allows.
